# Updated test cases for datetime parsing enhancements
import unittest
from lib.datetime_parser import Parser
class TestDatetimeParsing(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_dt_format_to_regex(self):
        # Test cases for dt_format_to_regex function
        parser = Parser('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
        regex = parser.dt_format_to_regex()
        self.assertIsNotNone(regex)
    def test_parser_single_digit_days_and_months(self):
        # Test cases for single-digit days and months
        parser = Parser('%d-%m-%Y')
        date_string = '1-2-2022'
        parsed_date = parser.parse(date_string)
        self.assertEqual(parsed_date.day, 1)
    def test_parser_colons_in_time_formats(self):
        # Test cases for colons in time formats
        parser = Parser('%H:%M:%S')
        date_string = '14:30:00'
        parsed_date = parser.parse(date_string)
        self.assertEqual(parsed_date.hour, 14)
    def test_parser_flexible_parsing_of_z(self):
        # Test cases for flexible parsing of %z
        parser = Parser('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%z')
        date_string = '2022-02-15 14:30:00+0530'
        parsed_date = parser.parse(date_string)
        self.assertEqual(parsed_date.utcoffset(), timedelta(hours=5, minutes=30))
    def test_parser_formatter_property(self):
        # Test cases for formatter property
        parser = Parser('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
        formatter = parser.formatter
        self.assertIsNotNone(formatter)
    def test_parser_floating_point_seconds(self):
        # Test cases for %f directive
        parser = Parser('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')
        date_string = '2022-02-15 14:30:00.000123'
        parsed_date = parser.parse(date_string)
        self.assertEqual(parsed_date.microsecond, 123000)
    def test_parser_hyphen_minus_characters(self):
        # Test cases for hyphen-minus characters in field names
        parser = Parser('%Y-%m-%d %H-%M-%S')
        date_string = '2022-02-15 14-30-00'
        parsed_date = parser.parse(date_string)
        self.assertEqual(parsed_date.year, 2022)
    def test_parser_grouping_characters(self):
        # Test cases for grouping characters in decimal format strings
        parser = Parser('%d, %m, %Y')
        date_string = '1, 2, 2022'
        parsed_date = parser.parse(date_string)
        self.assertEqual(parsed_date.day, 1)
    def test_extract_format(self):
        # Test cases for extract_format function
        parser = Parser('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
        date_string = '2022-02-15 14:30:00'
        format_string = parser.extract_format(date_string)
        self.assertEqual(format_string, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
